scope: Prepared device inputs; uncached backbone plus state-readout head. Synchronized steady calls exclude CPU checks, compile, input transfers and tokenization.
state_gate: FP16 state normalized RMSE <=0.002; FP32 allclose atol0.02/rtol0.005; all scores allclose atol0.02/rtol0.005; not a full-suite accuracy claim
pipeline_scope: Warm filesystem read of a real NanoSCIDOCS batch, CPU tokenization/batch construction, synchronous pageable H2D, uncached selected-backend backbone/head, D2H scores, JSON write without fsync. Excludes startup, dataset indexing, tokenizer initialization, compilation and profiling. Device-event elapsed can include CPU gaps.
